audited_source_corrections.action: Restored the defined arithmetic language L_N in the interpretation paragraph and called the full list nonlogical symbols rather than constants.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen paragraph switches from the defined L_N to L and calls a predicate and functions constants.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: வரையறுக்கப்பட்ட L_N மொழியையும் அதன் தருக்கமல்லாத குறியீடுகளையும் குறிப்பிடுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retain L and leave an undefined language; call functions and a predicate constants.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The preceding definition provides only L_N, and the paragraph explicitly assigns all its relation and operation symbols.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does L_N match the intended arithmetic signature here?

audited_source_corrections.action: Typed the interpretation of < as a subset of the domain squared.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen formula uses M^2 although M names the structure and its carrier was just named Domain(M).
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treat M as both structure and underlying set without saying so.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: A binary relation in this interpretation is a subset of Domain(M) squared.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is Domain(M)^2 the correct carrier for the interpreted binary predicate?

audited_source_corrections.action: Restored x-star < y after ruling out x-star = y.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen sentence concludes x < y, which merely repeats its hypothesis instead of using the displayed successor dichotomy.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: இரண்டாவது நேர்வு நீக்கப்பட்ட பின் வலுவான x-star சிறியது y என்ற முடிவை எழுதுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keep the repeated x < y and leave the proof step vacuous.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The immediately preceding disjunction is x-star < y or x-star = y, and non-equivalence rules out only the latter.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the conclusion x-star < y follow from the stated case split?

audited_source_corrections.action: Qualified the lifted order to distinct equivalence classes.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen statement says x < y implies the block of x is below the block of y, but x and y may lie in the same block.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: ஒரே தொகுதியில் உள்ள x,y ஐத் தவிர்த்து, வெவ்வேறு தொகுதிகளுக்கே வரிசையை உயர்த்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keep a strict order of a block below itself.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The preceding item establishes separation only when x is not equivalent to y; a strict quotient order is defined on distinct blocks.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is the distinct-block qualification sufficient and faithful to the surrounding proof?

audited_source_corrections.action: Replaced the inner universal x by existential x in the parity sentence.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen sentence claims every y equals two x or two x plus one for every x, which is false in the standard natural numbers.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: ஒவ்வொரு y க்கும் ஏதோவொரு x உள்ளது என்ற இருத்தல் அளவையடையை மீட்டமைக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keep the universal x and derive the next existence claim from a false sentence.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Division with remainder one says every y has some quotient x, and the next sentence explicitly invokes that existence in M.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the existential x exactly state the required parity fact?

audited_source_corrections.action: Specified that the exercise's automorphism is of the ordered reduct.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen exercise says automorphism of Domain(M) without naming a structure, although a shift need not preserve addition or multiplication.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Read the automorphism as preserving the full arithmetic language.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The preceding conclusion proves only isomorphism of the <,= reducts; the exercise works in the same order language L.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the order-reduct clarification remove ambiguity without changing the exercise?

audited_source_corrections.action: Restricted the doubly infinite Z-chain description to nonstandard blocks.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen text says each equivalence block is doubly infinite, but the standard block begins at zero and has no predecessor there.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: இரு திசைகளிலும் முடிவிலாத சங்கிலி என்பது நிலையற்ற தொகுதிகளுக்கே என்று தெளிவுபடுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Claim the standard block has predecessors below zero.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The earlier standard-part clause is order-isomorphic to the natural numbers with least element z; only nonstandard blocks have predecessors at every point.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does restricting the Z-chain claim to nonstandard blocks preserve the later order-type argument?
